sources.snippet: Sources: model/u2net.py 422-525 Design Advantages The U²-Net architecture offers several advantages: Nested U-structure: By using RSU blocks as building units, the network can efficiently extract and combine multi-scale features, which is crucial for accurate salient object detection.

sources.title: xuebinqin/U-2-Net | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope U²-Net (U Square Net) is a deep neural network architecture designed for salient object detection (SOD). This repository provides implementations for training, testing, and using the U²-Net model across various applications including salient object detection, portrait generation, human segmentation, and background removal.
